title: Optimal Fully Dynamic Matching on the Line: Lean Upper Bound
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of the main constructive upper bound for fully dynamic matching on the unit interval. For every inventory size m at least two, the development constructs a measurable online policy for iid uniform demand and replenishment. From every fixed initial inventory it proves a limsup root-mean-square one-period cost of at most C log(m+1)/m, with the explicit universal constant C = 72000/log(2). After a scheduled m-period replacement phase, it proves the same upper bound for expected average cost at every horizon N at least 2m^2. The compared result deliberately excludes the manuscript's implementation-complexity sentence because the development has no operational cost semantics linking abstract counters to execution.
